(2) The man balances the heavy black snake across the back of his neck and shoulders, gripping its body with both hands to maintain control. The background is filled with long tables covered in white plastic storage bins, while many other attendees walk through the aisles of the convention center. (3) The man continues to hold the large snake, now laughing and engaging in conversation with the person in the blue sweatshirt. The camera remains relatively steady with minor handheld vibrations, focusing on the man's upper body and the reptile.
